projects.title: EVOX
projects.description:
EVOX is a 3D life simulator game, fully equipped with the ability to create your own worlds and inhabit them with custom creatures. Inspired by Conway's Game of Life, the purpose was to create a more visual and interactive gameplay experience while maintaining the fundamental concept of survival of the fittest. 

•	Used the MEAN stack and Voxel.js/Three.js for 3D gameplay
•	Integrated Voxel with the front end using Angular factories and controllers
•	Designed a robust backend to manage intricate requests and handle complex data types
•	Created a custom height mapping algorithm to generate randomized multilevel terrains

projects.title: UI-DV
projects.description:
UI-DV is a data visualization library that was built from the ground up to integrate seamlessly with Angular. Users can select from various graph types (bar, dot, circle bar, pie chart) and easily customize them by passing in desired attributes (size, colors, functions, etc). 

•	Implemented graphs as Angular directives that are highly configurable and extensive
•	Competed in a Fullstack hackathon and won Most Useful Developer Tool
